name: sticky
description: Re-posts a configured message to the bottom of a channel every time a new message is sent there.
short: Keep a message pinned to the bottom of a channel.

configFields.label: Sticky Entries
configFields.description: One entry per channel. The old sticky post is deleted before the new one goes up.

subfields.label: Channel
subfields.description: Channel the sticky message is re-posted in.

subfields.label: Message
subfields.description: Plain-text message re-posted after every new message in the channel.

subfields.label: Enabled
subfields.description: Whether this sticky entry is active.

subfields.label: Accent Color
subfields.description: Card accent bar as hex (e.g. #5865F2). Empty uses the default.

subfields.label: Images
subfields.description: Image URLs shown as a gallery (max 10).

subfields.label: Thumbnail
subfields.description: Small image shown beside the message text. Image URL.

subfields.label: Advanced Layout
subfields.description: Optional block-based layout (Section, Media Gallery, Separator, Action Row) for this sticky message. When it has any blocks, it replaces the plain message text above.
